description: A fake bookings desk asks for a call back and for a code by text, and quotes another guest's number.

messages.text: Good morning, this is the bookings desk. Your holiday payment did not go through.
Oh no. What do I need to do?
Please call our payments team on +44 7700 900456 today to complete the booking.
Another guest, Test Contact, had the same problem last week and rang us from 07700 900987. It was sorted in minutes.
If you cannot call, text the six-digit code we send you to +44 7700 900321 and we will finish it for you.
